svg.title: GB200 NVL72 network fabric illustration
svg.desc: Schematic cable routes. Four installed compute racks and full single-SU fabric capacity. See TECHNICAL_BASIS.md.

g.text: 72 GPUs → 18 NVSwitch ASICs per rack · 1,296 logical NVLink connections per rack
Rear cartridge harnesses shown schematically. NVLink does not cross between these racks.
